# Scrub Identity

> > Fashion-forward nursing scrubs, uniforms, and medical apparel from top brands like Koi Cureology, Momentum, Med Couture, and Epic.

Scrub Identity is a comprehensive e-commerce platform specializing in medical apparel and nursing uniforms for healthcare professionals. The site features an extensive catalog of scrubs, lab coats, and accessories organized by style, fit, brand, and gender, with a focus on women's scrub tops and pants.
